messages:
tian: Quick async standup for the Monday canary -> prod roll. TL;DR: canary slice 3% currently, no customer-facing errors, a couple CRs blocking full ramp. What I did / blockers / today:

sam: Did the slice warmup and smoke tests for slice-3. Load looks fine, 95p latency ~220ms (expected), error rate ~0.2% from one noisy pod.

maria: Noted. I ran a fast grep over logs, looks like the noisy pod is hitting an old model variant; I flagged it to rollout-bot to exclude and start a replacement.

ashley: Observability: traces show a small spike on feature flag ff/new-routing for requests with long prompts. I pushed a dashboard panel highlighting ff/new-routing && latency>200ms.

sam: @leo can you take a quick look at PR#4521 (routing fallback) and #4523 (kv-cache tweak)? Those are the last two PRs blocking the 10% ramp. Small nits but need your ✅.

leo: On it; will review in next 30m. FYI I left one comment on #4521 re: a fallback timeout default.

maria: Release-bot announced next ramp window at 11:30 UTC. If we get CRs + smoke green, we can go to 10% at that window.

release-bot: Canary ramp window scheduled: 2026-03-17T11:30:00Z. Target slice change: 3% -> 10%. Auto-rollback threshold: error-rate > 1% or pod-restarts > 3/min.

tian: Blockers: waiting on leo for CRs; also need validation from perf team on the kv-cache tweak (Sam, did you get perf numbers?).

sam: Perf numbers: locally seen ~6% cost reduction for long-seq flows with kv-cache tweak; on-canary metrics are noisy but trending same. I'll paste the quick query for perf folks:

  ```
  sum(rate(redwood_token_processed[5m])) by (model_variant)
  ```

ashley: Ops checklist done except for one alert rule change (we need to temporarily lower the error threshold to catch regressions early). I'll make the alert change 10m before ramp.

maria: Quick QA ask: can we add a small synthetic with long prompt at 5 RPS during the ramp? Will catch the ff/new-routing latency case. I can own this.

tian: Yes please @maria — schedule it for 11:35 UTC. If it spikes, we abort and roll back to 3%.

leo: Reviews complete, left minor doc nit. Merged #4521 and #4523. @sam please bump the canary image tag.

sam: Done. Pushed tag v2026.03.17-canary. Kicking off slice update now:

  ```bash
  kubectl set image deploy/redwood-gateway redwood-gateway=ghcr.io/redwood/gateway:v2026.03.17-canary -n prod-slice3
  kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-gateway -n prod-slice3
  ```

ashley: Watching logs + traces. If we see request errors > 1% in the next 10m I will trigger rollback.

release-bot: Canary update: new image tag applied to prod-slice3. Monitoring 5m.

maria: Synthetic started at 11:35 UTC (5 RPS, long prompt). I will post quick snapshot in 10m.

tian: Thanks team. If anything looks off ping #oncall and drop a short note here. Otherwise we proceed to 10% at 11:30 window and re-evaluate at +30m. :thumbsup:
